title: Find the intersections
text: $$6sin\left(\theta\right)=3$$ when $$sin(\theta)=\frac{1}{2}$$, at $$\theta=\frac{\pi}{6}$$ and $$\theta=\frac{5\pi}{6}$$. From $$0$$ to $$\frac{\pi}{6}$$ the curve $$r=6sin\left(\theta\right)$$ is the inner boundary, and from $$\frac{\pi}{6}$$ to $$\frac{\pi}{2}$$ the circle $$r=3$$ is.

title: Use symmetry
text: The region is symmetric about the y-axis, so double the right half: $$A=2\left(\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}**{\pi/6}36\sin**2\theta\,d\theta+\frac{1}{2}\int_{\pi/6}**{\pi/2}9\,d\theta\right)=6\pi-\frac{9\sqrt{3}}{2}$$
